remarks: Rare availablity! This one-Bedroom, Bright, spacious & pet friendly apartment in desirable Fairgate is ready for occupancy! Located on the brim of vibrant downtown Stamford, this home offers modern living and great value! Enjoy a pretty eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a sundrenched living/dining area + an accommodating bedroom with plenty of light & storage. You'll also enjoy your own private entrance, washer/dryer and off-street parking. With natural gas heat, central a/c, hot water on demand, 5-star energy rated appliances AND NO ADDITIONAL FEES - you'll be living your best life! The Fairgate community also features on-site management, 24-hour security and meticulously maintained grounds! Pets are permitted with the following restrictions: 1 dog 35 lbs., 2 cats, or 1-dog and 1-cat OK. There is a $300 refundable deposit required for all pets. Interested applicants must complete the Fairgate Application uploaded in supplements and credit check through applyconnect only.
